info.title: Goldbelly Universal API
info.description: Goldbelly 3PL API wrapper for orders, tracking, product inventory, subproduct inventory, and gift cards.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

orders[].description: Orders to update. Each item must include a customer reference number and may include merchant status or tracking number.

orders[].customerReferenceNumber.description: Customer reference number for the order to update.

orders[].merchantStatus.description: Merchant status to set for the order.

orders[].trackingNumber.description: Tracking number to set for the order.
